Script verifies only linear-algebra numerics, not derived closedness, and BGm-vs-mu_3 language is loose, but stable-locus headline holds with stated limitations.

The g=2,r=3 trace-center splitting and 2-shifted-center vanishing are mechanical instances. A failed literal search or timestamp does not establish priority.
